title: Kirby Problem 1.33
exact_target: Characterize the single-parity support of HOMFLYPT homology and test its implications for positivity and quasipositivity, as well as its occurrence for algebraic links.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2692 (KP-1.33). CC BY 4.0.
